questions.question_english: Match the types of validity in List I with their defining characteristics in List II. List I: (Type of Validity) P. Content Validity Q. Predictive Validity R. Construct Validity S. Concurrent Validity List II: (Characteristic)
questions.explanation_english: Content validity reflects how well test items represent subject matter. Predictive validity measures correlation with future performance outcomes. questions.question_english: Which of the following terms best describes a measurement error where a teacher tends to grade all students toward the middle of the scale, avoiding extreme high or low scores?
questions.explanation_english: Central tendency error occurs when evaluators avoid assigning extreme high or low marks, rating most individuals near the middle of the scale. This error distorts performance variability, reducing test discrimination and obscuring true differences between high and low performers.

questions.question_english: A test item has a negative discrimination index. This indicates that:
options_english: More low-performing students answered the item correctly than high-performing students
The question was mathematically too difficult and completely unanswerable for all test-takers
The item perfectly and reliably discriminates between high-achieving and low-achieving students
The test item contains a critical typographical formatting or major question printing error
questions.explanation_english: A negative discrimination index occurs when more students in the lower-scoring group answer an item correctly than those in the upper-scoring group. This inverse relationship indicates a psychometrically flawed item, often caused by misleading wording, incorrect answer keys, or confusing options that mislead high achievers.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। एक नकारात्मक विभेदन सूचकांक तब होता है जब निम्न-स्कोरिंग समूह के अधिक छात्र एक वस्तु को सही उत्तर देते हैं बनाम उच्च-स्कोरिंग समूह के। यह विपरीत संबंध एक मनोमिति से दोषपूर्ण वस्तु को इंगित करता है, जो अक्सर भ्रामक शब्दावली, गलत उत्तर कुंजी, या भ्रमित करने वाले विकल्पों के कारण होता है जो उच्च प्रदर्शन करने वालों को भटका देते हैं।
questions.topic: Educational Measurement Concepts Tools and Techniques
key_facts: A negative discrimination index indicates flawed test items.
Printed answer key: (A) More low-performing students answered the item correctly than high-performing students.

57. The "Discrimination Index" of a test item measures:
(A) How accurately and comprehensively the individual test item aligns with the prescribed curriculum framework
(B) The degree to which an item differentiates between students scoring high on the overall test and those scoring low
(C) Whether an individual question systematically favors a specific gender, cultural background, or socioeconomic status

questions.explanation_english: The discrimination index measures an item's capacity to differentiate between high-achieving and low-achieving examinees. 28. Consider the following examples of educational data:
I. Ranks of students in a class based on final exam scores (1st, 2nd, 3rd)
II. Percentile bands assigned to students in a national level exam
III. Classifying students into 'Pass' or 'Fail' categories
IV. The exact height of students in centimeters
Which of the examples given above represent the Ordinal Scale of measurement?
questions.explanation_english: Class ranks and percentile bands represent the ordinal scale of measurement because they establish a clear hierarchical order or rank among individuals based on relative performance. They indicate relative standing without assuming equal mathematical intervals between ranks, whereas binary pass-fail labels are nominal and exact physical height measurements reflect ratio scales.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। कक्षा की रैंक और पर्सेंटाइल बैंड क्रमांक माप के पैमाने का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं क्योंकि वे व्यक्तियों के बीच स्पष्ट पदानुक्रम या रैंक स्थापित करते हैं। ये रैंक के बीच समान गणितीय अंतराल मानने के बिना सापेक्ष स्थिति को इंगित करते हैं, जबकि बाइनरी पास-फेल लेबल नाममात्र होते हैं और सटीक भौतिक ऊँचाई माप अनुपात स्केल को दर्शाते हैं।
questions.topic: Educational Measurement Concepts Tools and Techniques
key_facts: Class ranks and percentile bands indicate relative standing.
Ordinal scales do not assume equal intervals between ranks.
Printed answer key: (A) I and II only

questions.question_english: In educational statistics, a "Normal Probability Curve" (NPC) is characterized by:
options_english: Possessing a distinct asymmetric curve that is skewed heavily to the right
Having equal Mean, Median, and Mode values positioned at the central axis
Exhibiting two distinct peak values forming a bimodal score distribution
Possessing flattened tails touching the baseline at fixed standard deviations
questions.explanation_english: A normal probability curve is a symmetrical, bell-shaped distribution where the mean, median, and mode coincide at the exact center. questions.question_english: The concept of "Measurement" in the context of physical attributes (e.g., height, weight) usually employs which scale?
questions.explanation_english: Physical attributes such as height and weight are measured on ratio scales. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। भौतिक गुण जैसे ऊँचाई और वजन अनुपात पैमानों पर मापे जाते हैं। अनुपात पैमाने समान इकाई अंतराल और एक निरपेक्ष शून्य बिंदु को दर्शाते हैं जो भौतिक गुण की कुल अनुपस्थिति का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जिससे वैध अनुपात तुलना संभव होती है। इसका अर्थ है कि कोई यह कह सकता है कि जो व्यक्ति 80 किलोग्राम है, वह 40 किलोग्राम वाले व्यक्ति से दो गुना भारी है।

questions.question_english:
42. Consider the following statements about
Anecdotal Records:
I. They should include both the factual description of the incident and the teacher's interpretation.
II. The interpretation must be strictly separated from the factual description.
III. They are most useful when only negative incidents are recorded for disciplinary action.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Anecdotal records should contain both an objective description of the observed event and the teacher's interpretation. To maintain observational validity, factual descriptions must remain clearly separated from personal interpretations. Furthermore, anecdotal records should document both positive and challenging behaviors to ensure a balanced, holistic evaluation of student growth.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। अनुकथात्मक अभिलेखों में अवलोकित घटना का वस्तुनिष्ठ विवरण और शिक्षक की व्याख्या दोनों शामिल होनी चाहिए। अवलोकनात्मक वैधता बनाए रखने के लिए, तथ्यात्मक विवरणों को व्यक्तिगत व्याख्याओं से स्पष्ट रूप से अलग रखा जाना चाहिए। इसके अलावा, अनुकथात्मक अभिलेखों में सकारात्मक और चुनौतीपूर्ण व्यवहार दोनों का दस्तावेजीकरण होना चाहिए ताकि छात्रों की वृद्धि का संतुलित और समग्र मूल्यांकन सुनिश्चित किया जा सके।
